_doc: Starter notebooks in my-quantum-programs/ that come from another project, pinned like the demos: each file is 'path' in 'repo_url' at commit 'ref' (upstream_sha256), with our 'edits' to single cells applied (sha256 of the copy we ship). The Hello World notebook is doQumentation's, so a learner meets the same first circuit on the Pi and on doqumentation.org; the edits keep its account cell from saving the placeholders over an IBM Quantum account already saved on the Pi, and its real-hardware cells say what to do when no account is saved instead of ending in an AccountNotFoundError (#25). Check or move a pin with RQB2-bin/rq_starter_sync.py (development tool).

edits.replace: if you haven't saved your credentials yet in this Binder session, run the cell below.
edits.with: if you have not saved your IBM Quantum account on this Pi yet, run the cell below (or use the RasQberry menu: **IBM Quantum account** → **Save my API key**).

edits.source:
from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService

token = "<your-api-key>"
instance = "<your-crn>"

# RasQberry: the placeholders never replace an account saved on this Pi
if token.startswith("<") or instance.startswith("<"):
    print("Put your API key and CRN in the two lines above first. Nothing was saved.")
else:
    QiskitRuntimeService.save_account(
        channel="ibm_quantum_platform",
        token=token,
        instance=instance,
        set_as_default=True,
        overwrite=True,
    )
    print("Saved. Your programs can now use QiskitRuntimeService().")

from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService, SamplerV2
from qiskit_ibm_runtime.accounts import AccountNotFoundError
from qiskit.transpiler.preset_passmanagers import generate_preset_pass_manager

# RasQberry: without a saved account, say what to do instead of an error
try:
    service = QiskitRuntimeService()
except AccountNotFoundError:
    service = None
    print("No IBM Quantum account is saved on this Pi yet. Save yours first (the cell above,")
    print("or the RasQberry menu: IBM Quantum account > Save my API key), then run this cell again.")

if service is not None:
    backend = service.least_busy(operational=True, simulator=False)
    print(f"Running on {backend.name}")

    pm = generate_preset_pass_manager(backend=backend, optimization_level=1)
    isa_qc = pm.run(qc)

    result = SamplerV2(mode=backend).run([isa_qc], shots=1024).result()
    counts = result[0].data.meas.get_counts()
    display(counts)
